凯拥有他的大灰猫，真值得庆幸。
大灰猫及时出现在凯的身边，用他的赞扬纠正了凯对于自己的判断。
大灰猫真有那么神奇吗？相比大人们消极的抱怨方式，
它只不过是用一种耐心积极的方式完成了爱和期待的表达，
其实就这么简单。
大灰猫看到了孩子眼里的世界，它更懂得安抚和鼓励的巨大推动力。
而我们也该庆幸自己有一本这样完美的图画书了。
康萍（作家、儿童心理研究者、戏剧学博士）

Can Kai Do It!
[Germany] Cantit Schleben Wick / Text
[Germany] Karola Holland / Illustrations
Wang Xiaocui / Translator

Kai owns his gray cat, truly something to be grateful for.
The gray cat appears in time by Kai's side, using his praise to correct Kai's self-judgment.
Is the gray cat really that magical? Compared to adults' negative complaints,
it simply expresses love and expectations in a patient and positive way.
It's actually that simple.
The gray cat sees the world through a child's eyes; it understands the great power of comfort and encouragement.
And we should also be grateful to have such a perfect picture book.
Kang Ping (Writer, Child Psychology Researcher, Drama Doctor)

这可真是太离奇了。
每一次，当凯想要快步跑去什么地方的时候，总会发生这样的事——
平坦的马路上，会突然长出一块幸灾乐祸的小石头。
有时候也许是一个台阶。当然喽，凯就摔倒了。
不用说，膝盖擦破了，T恤衫弄脏了，
一条裤腿撕裂了。凯哭了。
妈妈当然会安慰他。
不过，妈妈接下来就会说：‘你就不能小心一点吗？’
page_text_en:
This is really strange.
Every time Kai wants to run quickly somewhere, something like this always happens—
On a flat road, a mischievous little stone suddenly appears.
Sometimes it might be a step. Of course, Kai falls down.
Needless to say, his knee gets scraped, his T-shirt gets dirty,
and one pant leg tears. Kai cries.
Mom will certainly comfort him.
But then, Mom will say: 'Can't you be more careful?'
summary_zh: 本页通过多个画面和文字描述了男孩凯在奔跑时总是意外摔倒的情景，包括被‘幸灾乐祸的小石头’绊倒或在台阶上摔倒，导致受伤哭泣，妈妈虽然安慰他，但也会责备他不够小心。

没有谁能那么快地抓住已经跳起来的杯子。
自然，妈妈又会大声地说：

“你就不能小心一点吗？”

冬天更麻烦。因为太冷了，我们要穿内衣、长筒袜、牛仔裤、防潮的吊带外裤、毛衣，还有挡风的厚夹克。
当然也少不了围巾、手套、帽子和皮靴。
不知道什么时候，袖子回到了它们自己的地方，坏了的拉链修好了，靴子对号入座了，散开的鞋带也系好了。可是，穿戴得整整齐齐的凯却说：

妈妈瞪了他一眼，什么也没说。
不过，凯知道她想说什么。
page_text_en:
Winter is more troublesome. Because it's so cold, we have to wear underwear, long socks, jeans, moisture-proof overalls, sweaters, and windproof thick jackets.
Of course, we also need scarves, gloves, hats, and boots.
At some point, the sleeves returned to their proper places, the broken zipper was fixed, the boots were properly fitted, and the loose shoelaces were tied. But then, fully dressed Kai said:
"I need to go to the bathroom."
Mom gave him a stern look and said nothing.
But Kai knew what she was thinking.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了男孩凯在冬天穿衣服的繁琐过程，尽管他最终穿戴整齐，却在关键时刻提出上厕所，妈妈虽未言语，但凯明白她内心的无奈与责备。

Sometimes it's about books.

But when he's reading in the middle of a story, the book seems to suddenly run away.

Kai naturally has to catch it.

What happens? Another page gets torn.

At this point, Mom will say to Dad:

"This child is such a worry! How can our child be so clumsy?"
summary_zh: 本页描述了男孩凯在阅读图画书时，因书页‘跑掉’而伸手去抓，导致书被撕破的情景，妈妈因此向爸爸抱怨孩子太让人操心、太笨拙。

Kai sat in his own room, a big bump on his forehead because he had just accidentally bumped into the corner of a table.
Suddenly, a large gray cat jumped onto his bed. For someone who had raised a big gray cat, this wasn't strange at all.
But Kai had never had such a big gray cat. He didn't have a gray cat; he only had trouble.
"What's bothering you?"
The big gray cat asked.
"I don't know," Kai said.
I'm too clumsy.
I always do the wrong things.
Mom says I'm annoying.
And my head hurts.
summary_zh: 男孩凯因撞到桌子角而额头起包，感到沮丧和自责，一只大灰猫跳上床与他对话，凯向猫倾诉自己总是做错事、被妈妈责备，并感到头疼。

Kai and his mom returned home, and he saw the big gray cat sitting in front of the door on the balcony.

Maybe a bowl of water would be better? Kai thought.
"You're very clever when you take care of the cat," said the big gray cat.
Then, it began to chew the cheese pieces with relish.
summary_zh: 凯和妈妈回家后，发现大灰猫坐在阳台门前。凯以为它是神猫，便把面包里的奶酪掰碎放在盘子里喂它，还想着要不要加水。大灰猫称赞凯照顾猫咪很聪明，并津津有味地吃起了奶酪。

Karola can do it:
She can't speak fluent Italian. Even if her family is very strict, she still desperately eats snacks. And she simply doesn't know how to handle money. But she can pass on happiness to others, she's happy like a little princess, and she can draw fun pictures.

summary_zh: 本页以儿童涂鸦风格呈现两个角色——埃蒂特和卡罗拉——的自我肯定，分别描述了她们虽在某些方面不擅长，但拥有独特优点和能力，如理解小猫、讲故事、传递快乐和画画，强调每个人都有自己的价值。
